'''''Parodia warasii''''' is a [[cactus]] native to [[Brazil]]. Its small range is threatened by [[landslide]]s.<ref name=iucn>{{Cite journal|last=IUCN|title=Parodia warasii: Larocca, J. & Machado, M.|journal=IUCN Red List of Threatened Species|doi=10.2305/iucn.uk.2013-1.rlts.t152200a609051.en|year=2010|doi-access=free}}</ref>
